summary: The Russian base's source of power. It has no weapon: the supply center, barracks, vehicle factory, airfield, Geran launch site and Kornet emplacement all draw on what it makes, and a shortage slows production and silences the emplacement.

sections.title: Power the base
sections.how: Select a dozer, open the Build tab, press Power plant and left-click the ground.
sections.body: The dozer raises the plant on its own. Its power counts only once the building is complete, and it keeps working while the plant is damaged. Production runs at full speed while the base makes at least as much power as it consumes.

sections.title: When power runs short
sections.how: Watch the power reading in the HUD.
sections.body: If the base consumes more power than it produces, the reading turns red and production slows sharply, though it never stops. The Kornet emplacement is the only Russian defense that needs power, so it holds its fire until the deficit is fixed. Add another plant or sell something that draws power.

sections.title: Repair with a dozer
sections.how: Select a dozer and left-click the damaged power plant.
sections.body: The dozer drives to the plant and restores it until it is whole. The work costs half the build price as the health comes back, and only one dozer works on a building at a time. If the credits run out, the repair stops and the dozer goes idle.

sections.title: Sell
sections.how: Select the power plant, press Sell, then press Confirm.
sections.body: The plant sells for half its price and disappears at once, taking its power with it. Selling it while the base is already short of power makes the deficit worse. Selling your last building loses the match.

strong: Powering production and the Kornet emplacement
A compact building to place behind the line
tips: The barracks cannot be built until a power plant stands.
Build a second plant before the factories, airfield and defenses outgrow the first.
Losing power stops the Kornet emplacement firing, even against tanks.
Keep the plant behind the line: it is unarmed.
A damaged plant still powers the base; repair it before it is destroyed.
